ModMetaData.name: Mynock Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Mynock art (south/east/north facings only - flying-animation frames and the dessicated corpse texture stay on donor art) with custom hand-directed art via the Codex native-alpha pipeline. IKEE_MYNOCK_ART_REGEN_1 (2026-09-08): owner-directed hideous wet practical- creature-effects redesign, distended eyestalks per film reference. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Mynock/Mynock_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution - same mechanism this repo already uses for donor-texture overrides (formerly BlastDoorFrameAsyncFix, now folded into StarWarsPatches).
UNVERIFIED as of authoring: the donor ships these textures inside a Unity AssetBundle (AssetBundles/, no loose Textures/swanimals/ folder at all), not as loose files. Loose-overrides-loose-by-load-order is proven elsewhere in this repo; loose-overrides-AssetBundle-by-load-order is NOT yet confirmed working for this specific donor. Needs a live look (spawn/view a Mynock in-game) before this mod is trusted.
